subject: CLAIM encode-cpu-opus: nord2_transport.inc nord2_raw_call/map/unmap timing (device kernel-call breakdown line TEGU_PERF_KCALL)
body: Purpose: the next device run should say how much of 0.27 ms/job + 0.153 ms/draw is inside kernel calls (SUBMIT_JM, WAIT/WAIT_SEQ, SYNC, ALLOC/RELEASE/IMPORT, map/unmap) versus userspace building. It counts only and does not change behaviour.
